title: yummy aerated malaysian celeria aerated-celery-bowl
description: spicy, aerated, post-workout malaysian dish featuring celeriac, air-fry, satvik-friendly, served in a lacquerware bowl.

ingredients.name: air fryer oil
ingredients.notes: such as coconut oil or avocado oil

instructions: Peel and dice the celeriac into bite-sized pieces.
Rinse and dry the celeriac pieces with paper towels.
Mix the minced ginger, garlic, chili flakes, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Toss the celeriac pieces with the ginger-garlic mixture until they are evenly coated.
Air-fry the celeriac mixture for 10-12 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelized.
Let the celeriac cool for a few minutes before serving.
Chop the cucumber and carrot into bite-sized pieces.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
This dish is best served immediately, but it can be refrigerated for up to a day if needed.
